'''Sonism''' is a religious tradition associated with [[Solara]] in the extracted source material. The old Solara country source lists the religion as '''Sonist''', while the Solaran language and [[Solra]] sources link to '''Sonism'''.

== Source Role ==

The source set connects Sonism to Solara but gives no complete doctrine. Its relationship to [[Solra]], temple institutions, and ritual practice remains open until a dedicated religion pass or user canon ruling supplies those details.

== Canon Limits ==

This draft preserves Sonism as a source-attested Solaran religious identity only. It does not invent gods, clergy, rites, holy cities, or political powers.
